title: 校准排名反转：面向LLM公平比较的精度控制评估框架
summary: 论文指出全局校准指标（如ECE、Brier Score）在跨模型比较时受精度差异干扰，导致排名反转。提出ACE框架，通过实例对齐、分布对齐、候选对齐三种视角实现精度控制评估。实验表明，原始指标下的校准优势在控制精度后大幅减弱，公平比较需考虑精度因素。
summary_en: This paper shows that global calibration metrics (ECE, Brier Score) are confounded by accuracy differences in cross-model LLM comparisons, leading to ranking reversals. It proposes ACE, an accuracy-controlled evaluation framework with three complementary views. Experiments reveal that many reported calibration advantages weaken after accuracy control, advocating for accuracy-aware evaluation.
